school.school_name: 富山情報ビジネス専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find the target-form candidate from a dense information page with many adjacent disclosure links.
search_queries: 富山情報ビジネス専門学校 情報公開 修学支援
富山情報ビジネス専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
steps: Open the Bit BOX information page.
Use the 情報公開 section instead of general admissions or campus-life navigation.
Select the anchor labeled 修学支援に関する機関要件確認申請書.
Verify the PDF body contains 富山情報ビジネス専門学校 and 様式第２号.
Queue the PDF for operator review because the page label proves target-form shape but not an explicit FY2026 label.

reusable_rules: Prioritize anchors containing 修学支援 and 機関要件確認申請書 over adjacent 学校関係者評価, 授業担当科目, and シラバス links.
Treat exact school-name plus 様式第２号 in the PDF as target-form evidence.
If the link and body do not carry a reliable target-year label, queue review rather than auto-accept.
anti_patterns: Do not let adjacent disclosure PDFs consume the candidate budget before the 修学支援 anchor.
Do not infer FY2026 from unrelated dates such as handbook publication years or director terms.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-11 found the information-page anchor 修学支援に関する機関要件確認申請書 and verified the PDF body contains the school name and 様式第２号.
